useful_scope: Deterministic fail-closed verification/recovery for frozen executions: duplicate gate/problem suppression, uncertain reservation/dispatch containment, immutable evidence integrity checking, and frozen file pin drift/path-escape rejection.
invocation_contract: Use the Brain-owned atomic guard before consequential scarce/frozen execution; treat any uncertain persistence, duplicate reservation, corrupt record, or pin mismatch as non-admission.
recovery_behavior: Dispatch acknowledgement uncertain/nonpersisted -> report uncertainty and do not assume execution ownership.
Immutable record integrity mismatch -> reject record.
claim_limits: No claim of general semantic self-critique.
No claim of root-cause debugging intelligence.
No claim of arbitrary software recovery.
